connector.name: Auralogs
connector.registryDescription: Read-only access to Auralogs production logs: search logs, inspect errors, review AI analyses.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.auralogs.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.auralogs, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer aura_read_YOUR_KEY. Create a read-only project key in the Auralogs dashboard under Settings, API & MCP keys.
